surface_mechanism_description: The work function lowering at 1100 °C was attributed to metal-dielectric intermixing and oxygen vacancy formation, which led to the formation of TiN and TiSi phases at the interface.
evidence: The lowering of /H9021meff /H208494.91 eV /H20850 can be explained by intermixing causing the formation of TiN and TiSi phases at the interface after 1100 °C annealing.
